title: Nonempty finite abelian family stabilization
statement: Let $J$ be a small filtered category and $F:J\to\mathrm{Cat}$ a diagram of small categories [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $P_j$ be stage precoverages [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] with isomorphism covers, finite indexed base-change and composition stability [def-weil-pbc-finite-precoverage], and covering pullbacks. Suppose every covering presieve has finitely many arrows, transition functors send covers to covers, preserve pullbacks of covering arrows, and are continuous for the generated topologies. Let $V$ be a cocone with object and arrow set cocones colimiting [def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor]. Let $Q$ be a precoverage on $V.pt$ with the same finite closure, isomorphism-cover, and covering-pullback properties. Assume its covers are exactly transported stage covers, each $V_j$ preserves covering pullbacks and is continuous. Fix $i$ and an abelian sheaf $G$ on $P_i$. Write $A_t=F(t.hom)^{-1}G$ for $t\in\mathrm{Under}(i)$, and $H=V_i^{-1}G$. Let $\alpha_t:A_t\to V_t^*H$ be sheaf morphisms whose composites with the stage adjunction units agree, componentwise as arrows, with the $V_i$ adjunction unit. Assume the presieve $T$ below is nonempty. Fix $t\in\mathrm{Under}(i)$, an object $W\in F(t.right)$, a covering presieve $T\in P_{t.right}(W)$ and an $A_t$-valued family $y$ on $T$. Suppose the family $g\mapsto\alpha_t(y_g)$ is compatible on $T$ as a family in the restriction of $H$ along $V_t$. Then there exist $t'\in\mathrm{Under}(i)$, $W'\in F(t'.right)$, a cover $T'\in P_{t'.right}(W')$, an equality $h:V_{t'}W'=V_tW$, and a compatible $A_{t'}$-valued family $y'$ on $T'$ such that for every $g':Z'\to W'$ in $T'$ there are $g:Z\to W$ in $T$ and $r:V_{t'}Z'\to V_tZ$ with $V_{t'}(g')\circ h=r\circ V_t(g)$ and $\alpha_{t'}(y'_{g'})=H(r)(\alpha_t(y_g))$. No sieve or generated-section family on the colimit site is given, and no global amalgamation is asserted.

proof.text: For each transition in Under i construct its unit-characterized comparison morphism by the inverse of the stage adjunction hom-equivalence. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-colimit-site-abelian-finite-indexed-matching] to obtain a transition b at which the indexed family of comparison images is matching.

Use Mathlib Presieve.Arrows.Compatible.familyOfElements to descend the matching indexed family to the presieve of image arrows, including coincident image arrows. Identify this presieve with T.map(F(b.right)) by its constructors, and use hcover to prove it covers.

Cocone naturality gives the equality of target objects hW and the endpoint transport r for each indexed arrow; Functor.congr_hom proves the required factorization. Specializing the imported generalized sheaf_comparison_comp theorem from the indexed-matching module proves the triangle equation relating theta_b, alpha at the new stage, and alpha at the old stage. Transport its section-group endpoint along r and evaluate it at the corresponding y_g to obtain the alpha-image formula. The nonempty hypothesis is eliminated, but no weakening or change of the existing statement is made.
